final: SELECT COALESCE(o.orderbase, 'MISSING') as channel, COUNT(*) as execution_count, AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions oe2 JOIN orders o2 ON oe2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault) as share_of_total FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY COALESCE(o.orderbase, 'MISSING') ORDER BY execution_count DESC    -- shows channel, execution count, average filled quantity, and unrounded share of 1000 total executions
